firm_data.firm_description: Newman Ferrara represents many of the city's largest property owners and managing agents, and handles some of the nation's most significant class actions and civil rights matters. With over five decades of experience, the firm has evolved into a national practice focused on Real Estate, Commercial Litigation, Civil Rights, Class Actions and other Complex, Multiparty Litigation.
notable_facts: The firm's attorneys are regularly called upon by the media to offer their unique insights on the latest legal developments and trends.

email.subject: AI for Newman Ferrara, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Your firm's attorneys are regularly called upon by media to share insights on legal developments and trends, which speaks to the caliber of work Newman Ferrara delivers across real estate, commercial litigation, and complex multiparty matters.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like Newman Ferrara compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
